Order 
The applicants have filed this First bail application under Section 482 of BNSS/438 of Cr.P.C. for grant of anticipatory bail.

Applicants apprehend their arrest in connection with Crime No.02/2025 registered at Police Station - Gopalpur District Shivpuri (M.P.) in relation to the offence punishable under Sections 420, 34,
120-B, 467, 468 and 193 of the IPC.

2. Brief facts of the case are that cognizance has been taken by the NEUTRAL CITATION NO.
2026:MPHC-GWL:7728 2 MCRC-9714-2026 trial court vide order dated 24.01.2026 against the present applicants.

The allegation against the present applicants is that they along with other officials were involved and instrumental in fabricating the documents of the person by wrongly mentioning/verifying/approving the date of birth of the aforesaid person.
Accordingly, offence has been registered against the present applicants along with other co-accused persons.

sentences.text: 3. Learned counsel for the applicants submits that the applicants are innocent and have been falsely implicated in the present case.
The applicants were neither involved in making any documents nor fabricating any documents.
They only signed the Panchnama prepared by the concerned Patwari.
Even, never any complaint has been made against them regarding any indiscipline.
The present applicants had no ill-will to commit any fraud, but just performed their duties.
After registration of the FIR, the entire investigation was carried out by the investigating Officer strictly in accordance with the procedure prescribed under the Code of Criminal Procedure.
However, a bare perusal of the charge-sheet would reveal that there is not a shred of incriminating material against the present applicants.
No documentary or substantive evidence has been collected during the course of investigation to support the allegations levelled against them.
The name of the present applicants is not figured in the FIR also.

The alleged birth certificate was prepared and issued by the Panchayat Secretary strictly in pursuance of the order passed by the Tehsildar, Shivpuri, which order itself was passed after due verification and upon receipt of the report submitted by the concerned Patwari,
following the prescribed procedure.

The NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2026:MPHC-GWL:7728 3 MCRC-9714-2026 present applicants had no role whatsoever in the preparation, issuance, or verification of the said birth certificate, nor are they beneficiaries of the said certificate in any manner.
It is further submitted that there is no likelihood of the applicant absconding or tampering with the prosecution evidence.

The co-accused Bharat Suman Trivedi has already been enlarged on anticipatory bail by this Court vide order dated 25.02.2026 passed in M.Cr.C. No.6657/2026,
therefore, applicants seek parity also.

The applicants undertake to cooperate fully with the investigation as well as the trial proceedings and is willing to abide by any terms and conditions that may be imposed by this Court while granting bail.

4. Per contra, learned counsel for the State has vehemently opposed the application and has prayed for its rejection by submitting that there was sufficient material available on record against the present applicant.

5. Heard counsel for the parties and perused the case diary.
6.

Considering the overall facts and circumstances of the case and the nature of allegations and on the ground of parity also, without commenting on the merits of the case, this Court is of the view that the applicants deserve the benefit of anticipatory bail.

7. Accordingly, it is hereby directed that in the event of arrest, the applicants shall be released on bail on furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand only) each with one solvent surety each of the like amount to the satisfaction of Arresting Authority/Investigating Officer.

8. This order will remain operative subject to compliance of the NEUTRAL CITATION NO.
2026:MPHC-GWL:7728 4 MCRC-9714-2026 following conditions by the applicant:-
1.
